name: design-harness
description: Review before show for UI work: a Stop hook holds any turn that changed rendered files until a fresh-context reviewer has compared the change with its sibling surfaces, the project's settled rules and the AI-look register, and checked copy length, token drift, accessibility, line breaks and layout. Taste is never gated: a direction skill shows outside candidates one at a time, has fresh agents build whole-page directions (one a no-context control) and lets the designer pick blind, with an art-direction critic as an optional second opinion. Plus a mood-board kickoff and a learn skill that turns corrections into rules and picks into a record. Ships inspo, real production websites over MCP, as a reference source.
